name: DBT-Junior Research Fellowship (DBT-JRF) through Biotechnology Eligibility Test (BET) 2026
provider: Department of Biotechnology, Government of India (nodal agency: Regional Centre for Biotechnology, Faridabad)

rules.value: Indian citizens residing in India; research in biotechnology in India
rules.quote: Applications are invited from bonafide Indian citizens, residing in India for the award of ‘DBT-Junior Research Fellowship’ (DBT-JRF) to pursue research in frontier areas of Biotechnology across the country.

value: Master's (MSc/MTech/MVSc/MPharm/Integrated MSc/MTech/MBBS) or 4-year UG in Biotechnology/Life Sciences or allied disciplines
rules.quote: Candidates holding a Master’s degree or equivalent (M.Sc. /M.Tech. /M.VSc./ M.Pharm. /Integrated M.Sc./M.Tech./MBBS) in Biotechnology/Life Sciences or allied disciplines
with minimum 60% of marks for General, EWS & OBC category and 55% of marks for SC/ ST/Differently Abled candidates in aggregate (or equivalent grade).
For a 4 year/8 semester bachelor’s degree (with research): minimum 75% marks in aggregate or its equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed.

Age Limit : Upto 28 years of age as on the last date of application for General & EWS category. Age relaxation of up to 5 years (33 years) for SC/ ST/ Differently Abled/ women candidates and upto 3 years (31 years) for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates.
Candidates will be shortlisted on merit by computer-based ‘Biotechnology Eligibility Test (BET).

rules.value: must register for PhD within 2 years of award letter
rules.quote: Category-I entitles a shortlisted candidate for activation of fellowship subject to joining Ph.D. Programme and subsequent registration of Ph.D. from recognized University/ Institution across India within two (2) years from the date of issuance of award letter.

amount.text: JRF Rs 37,000 pm for 2 years; SRF Rs 42,000 pm for next 3 years; HRA if applicable; contingency Rs 30,000 pa
amount.quote: a fellow shall be designated as ‘Senior Research Fellow’ (SRF) entitled for enhanced fellowship of Rs. 42,000/- per month for remaining duration of three (03) years. Additionally, a DBT JRF/ SRF is entitled to avail HRA (if applicable) and Rs. 30,000/- contingency per annum on pro-rata basis.

deadline.text: BET 2026 applications 19 March to 9 April 2026; exam 17 May 2026
deadline.quote: Closing Date of submission of online application 9th April 2026 (up to 5.00 PM)
